_comment: Pinned program for the count query 'How many players are visible?' on bernabeu-counter. Hits an op-path the hero chain never does: detect -> count -> answer (no crop/read_text/filter/temporal_order). The window 11750-11751ms @ fps1 samples the single midpoint frame of the codegen hint window (t=(9000+14500)/2 — the same frame SYSTEM_PROMPT's count rule makes the free-text path sample, so the canned and live counts agree) — a close-up where the cache's 3 REAL Azure detections (Vinicius, the defender, the keeper) each align with a visible player, so count grounds to '3'. All 3 boxes sit on-pitch, so detect.on_pitch:true keeps every one (raw == kept — the arg still documents the crowd-filter posture). A wider window would multiply the count across frames; this single-frame window is the count analogue of test_generalized_answer's 4625-4626 probe. Validates against ../schema/dsl.schema.json. end_ms 11751 <= clip duration_ms 30086.
